title: ChemInform Abstract: Crystal Chemistry of Oxotantalates. Part 4. On the Metastable High Temperature Compound Mn2Zn3Ta6O20.
abstract: AbstractSingle crystals of the title compound are prepared by heating pressed pellets of MnO, ZnO, and Ta2O5 (1:2:1) at 2000 °C for more than 1 h. A second unknown tantalate, MnZn2Ta2O8, is obtained as a by‐product.
